pc_02f90111aabc0853.fix: match the two KNOWS conditions separately so they may use the same edge
pc_02f90111aabc0853.released: MATCH (p:Person {id: 6597069766841})-[:KNOWS*1..3]-(other:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(mod:Person)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(other) WHERE other <> p RETURN DISTINCT other.id AS personId, COUNT(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount ORDER BY forumCount DESC, personId ASC LIMIT 5
pc_02f90111aabc0853.corrected: MATCH (p:Person {id: 6597069766841})-[:KNOWS*1..3]-(other:Person) WHERE other <> p WITH DISTINCT other MATCH (other)-[:KNOWS]-(mod:Person)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(other) RETURN DISTINCT other.id AS personId, COUNT(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount ORDER BY forumCount DESC, personId ASC LIMIT 5

pc_44ed3256cd90c97b.fix: count each linked account once, in either direction, and keep accounts with only incoming transfers
pc_44ed3256cd90c97b.released: MATCH (a:Account)-[:TRANSFER_TO]->(b:Account) WHERE a <> b WITH a, COUNT(DISTINCT b) AS outCount OPTIONAL MATCH (a)<-[:TRANSFER_TO]-(c:Account) WHERE a <> c WITH a, outCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS inCount WITH a, outCount + inCount AS relatedCount RETURN DISTINCT a.accountId AS accountId, a.accountType AS accountType, a.isBlocked AS isBlocked, relatedCount ORDER BY relatedCount DESC LIMIT 10
pc_44ed3256cd90c97b.corrected: MATCH (a:Account)-[:TRANSFER_TO]-(b:Account) WHERE a <> b WITH a, COUNT(DISTINCT b) AS relatedCount RETURN DISTINCT a.accountId AS accountId, a.accountType AS accountType, a.isBlocked AS isBlocked, relatedCount ORDER BY relatedCount DESC LIMIT 10

pc_60ae64b5c6412d4c.released: MATCH (p:Person {id: 6597069766747}) RETURN DISTINCT EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post) WHERE po.creationDate < 20110601000000000 } AS likedPostBeforeJune2011 LIMIT 1
pc_60ae64b5c6412d4c.corrected: MATCH (p:Person {id: 6597069766747}) RETURN DISTINCT EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post) WHERE po.creationDate < 1306886400000 } AS likedPostBeforeJune2011 LIMIT 1

pc_702315dac5e12517.fix: require the three companies to be distinct
pc_702315dac5e12517.released: MATCH (c1:Company)-[g:GUARANTEE]->(c2:Company)-[i:INVEST]->(c3:Company) WHERE i.createTime > g.createTime RETURN DISTINCT c1.companyId AS guarantorCompanyId, c2.companyId AS investorCompanyId
pc_702315dac5e12517.corrected: MATCH (c1:Company)-[g:GUARANTEE]->(c2:Company)-[i:INVEST]->(c3:Company) WHERE i.createTime > g.createTime AND c1 <> c2 AND c3 <> c1 AND c3 <> c2 RETURN DISTINCT c1.companyId AS guarantorCompanyId, c2.companyId AS investorCompanyId

pc_96aadbfd62ae1c48.released: MATCH (f:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Country {name: 'China'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(m:Person) RETURN DISTINCT f.title AS forumTitle, mod.firstName + ' ' + mod.lastName AS moderatorName, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS memberCount
pc_96aadbfd62ae1c48.corrected: MATCH (f:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Country {name: 'China'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(m:Person) WITH f, mod, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS memberCount RETURN DISTINCT f.title AS forumTitle, mod.firstName + ' ' + mod.lastName AS moderatorName, memberCount

pc_98b1f679f2515ca9.fix: count only repayments from accounts the guaranteed person owns
pc_98b1f679f2515ca9.released: MATCH (g:Person)-[:GUARANTEE]->(p:Person)-[:APPLY_LOAN]->(l:Loan)<-[r:REPAY]-(a:Account) WITH g, p, sum(r.amount) AS sumRepaid WHERE sumRepaid > 5000.0 RETURN DISTINCT g.personId AS guarantorPersonId, g.personName AS guarantorPersonName, p.personName AS guaranteedPersonName, sumRepaid
pc_98b1f679f2515ca9.corrected: MATCH (g:Person)-[:GUARANTEE]->(p:Person)-[:APPLY_LOAN]->(l:Loan)<-[r:REPAY]-(a:Account)<-[:OWN_ACCOUNT]-(p) WITH g, p, sum(r.amount) AS sumRepaid WHERE sumRepaid > 5000.0 RETURN DISTINCT g.personId AS guarantorPersonId, g.personName AS guarantorPersonName, p.personName AS guaranteedPersonName, sumRepaid

pc_c8ae16a5acf229f4.fix: average over accounts with at least one outgoing transfer (convention C12)
pc_c8ae16a5acf229f4.released: MATCH (a:Account) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[t:TRANSFER_TO]->() WITH a.accountType AS accountType, a, count(t) AS outTransfers RETURN DISTINCT accountType, avg(outTransfers) AS avgOutgoingTransfers ORDER BY accountType
pc_c8ae16a5acf229f4.corrected: MATCH (a:Account)-[t:TRANSFER_TO]->() WITH a.accountType AS accountType, a, count(t) AS outTransfers RETURN DISTINCT accountType, avg(outTransfers) AS avgOutgoingTransfers ORDER BY accountType
